scoring_justification: Recomputing the full electronic-structure relaxation pipeline is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; we compare the agent's reported Peierls stresses and core energies to the paper's reported values with absolute tolerances and verify the required orientation ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Peierls stresses and ordering for Fe, W, Nb
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's stated results: Fe τ_p/μ = 0.054 (χ0°), 0.058 (χ-30°), 0.080 (χ+30°); W = 0.036, 0.032, 0.062; Nb values read from Fig.9 approximately 0.028, 0.026, 0.045.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference core energies per 102 atomic rows
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted: Fe=0.61 eV, Nb=0.27 eV, W=1.43 eV.

outputs.description: Dimensionless Peierls stresses τ_p/μ for each metal and shear orientation.
Zero-stress dislocation core energy in eV for each metal.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares agent-reported values to paper-reported references with absolute tolerances and also verifies the relative ordering: for Fe, τ_p(χ=0°) < τ_p(χ=-30°) < τ_p(χ=30°); for W and Nb, τ_p(χ=-30°) < τ_p(χ=0°) < τ_p(χ=30°).
